parameters.name: aspect_ratio
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const s = String($node["Code - Build Photography-Grade Prompt v3"].json.output_size || "1080x1080"); const m = s.match(/(\d+)\s*[x:]\s*(\d+)/i); if(!m) return "1:1"; const w=+m[1], h=+m[2]; if(w===h) return "1:1"; return w>h ? "16:9" : "9:16"; })() }}
